pendentes.alt: Sala de estar ao anoitecer com luz suave do teto, abajur aceso ao lado da poltrona e quadro iluminado por spot
pendentes.pedido: A cozy contemporary living room at dusk lit in three layers: soft warm recessed ceiling lights, a fabric-shade floor lamp glowing beside a walnut lounge chair, and a narrow ceiling spotlight washing an abstract painting on a textured off-white wall. Linen sofa, wool rug, oak floor, large window with deep blue evening sky. Interior design photography, eye level, warm 2700K ambience, the TV switched off.

pendentes.alt: Quarto tranquilo com cortinas grossas até o chão, tapete felpudo e estante cheia de livros encostada na parede
pendentes.pedido: A calm, quiet bedroom in soft evening light with heavy floor-length velvet curtains in muted sage green fully drawn, a thick cream shag rug over a wooden floor, an upholstered fabric headboard and a tall wooden bookcase filled with books with plain unmarked spines placed against the side wall. Warm bedside lamp glow, serene atmosphere. Interior design photography, eye level.

pendentes.alt: Sala clara com grandes janelas para um jardim, plantas em vasos de cerâmica, piso de madeira e sofá de linho
pendentes.pedido: A bright, calm living room designed with biophilic principles: large floor-to-ceiling windows opening onto a lush green garden, several leafy potted plants in matte terracotta and ceramic pots, a light oak wooden floor, a low linen sofa in natural beige, a jute rug and a solid wood coffee table with a small stone bowl. Soft diffuse morning daylight with gentle leaf shadows on a white wall. Interior design photography, wide angle, eye level.

pendentes.alt: Rua arborizada e tranquila de um bairro residencial com casas contemporâneas, muros baixos e jardins na frente
pendentes.pedido: A quiet, tree-lined residential street at golden hour with contemporary detached houses set back behind low stone walls and well-kept front gardens. Wide sidewalks, mature trees casting long shadows, clean architectural lines in white plaster, wood slats and large glass windows. No cars, no gates with signs. Architectural photography, eye level, warm natural light.

pendentes.alt: Sala de estar com tapete claro grande sob o sofá e as poltronas, mesa de centro de madeira e piso de tábuas aparecendo nas bordas
pendentes.pedido: A well-proportioned living room seen from above at a gentle angle: a large cream wool rug anchoring the seating area, with the front legs of a light gray sofa and two armchairs resting on it, a round solid wood coffee table in the center and a visible band of oak floorboards around the rug's edges. Soft natural daylight from a side window, calm neutral palette. Interior design photography.

pendentes.alt: Estrutura de concreto de um edifício residencial em construção, com lajes aparentes e luz suave do fim da tarde
pendentes.pedido: A clean, orderly construction site of a mid-rise residential building with exposed reinforced concrete slabs and columns, neatly stacked ceramic blocks and rolled architectural drawings resting on a wooden table in the foreground. Soft late-afternoon golden light, blue sky with a few clouds. Architectural photography, eye level, wide-angle lens, sharp focus. No workers present.

pendentes.alt: Quarto de casal sereno ao entardecer, com cama de linho claro, cortinas longas de tecido grosso e luz âmbar baixa de um abajur
pendentes.pedido: A serene master bedroom at dusk with a low bed dressed in crumpled off-white linen sheets and a soft wool throw, a solid oak headboard and a bedside table with a small ceramic lamp giving a warm amber glow. Heavy floor-to-ceiling curtains in a muted sage fabric, partly drawn over a large window showing a deep blue evening sky. A potted plant in the corner, wide-plank wooden floor and a textured rug. Interior design photography, calm and minimal, eye level.
